About Xylentrix

Built for modern data work.

Xylentrix is a technology services company built by experienced technology professionals. We help organizations solve complex data and technology challenges across cloud, open-source and enterprise environments.

From source to destination, we help turn fragmented technology into reliable business capability.

Our work spans architecture, engineering, platform modernization, analytics and specialized technology staffing. We focus on practical delivery: systems that are secure, maintainable and aligned to business outcomes.

Whether the requirement is a new cloud data platform, Hadoop modernization, analytics delivery or the right technical team, we bring a focused engineering approach to the engagement.
